encoding: RFC 8949 core deterministic encoding; untagged COSE structures
external_aad: zero-length for every Sig_structure in this profile

vectors.title: Credential (access token) presented in the proof slot
vectors.deny_rule: protected typ is not application/vnd.hyprstream.proof+cwt
vectors.notes: Denies before any claim is interpreted.

vectors.title: Proof CWT presented in the credential/authorization slot
vectors.deny_rule: credential verification requires the at+jwt or CWT access-token type and an issuer key; the proof carries the proof typ and is signed by a cnf-bound request-proof key
vectors.notes: Same bytes as P-2, presented in the wrong slot.

vectors.title: Protected typ (label 16) absent
vectors.deny_rule: RFC 9596 typ is REQUIRED in the body protected headers

vectors.title: Correct typ with response-proof hs_domain
vectors.deny_rule: typ and hs_domain must both match the request-proof profile

vectors.title: Hybrid proof with the ML-DSA-65 signature entry stripped
vectors.deny_rule: the retained Ed25519 entry's Sig_structure still covers the hybrid signature_plan, so it cannot verify under the standalone classical suite; the missing plan component denies independently
vectors.notes: The surviving Ed25519 signature is cryptographically valid over the mutated object.

vectors.title: signature_plan with nine signer groups
vectors.deny_rule: proof-v1 cap: 1*8 signer groups

vectors.title: signer group with three components
vectors.deny_rule: proof-v1 cap: 1*2 components per signer group

vectors.title: Unknown private-use claim key -70005 in the claims set
vectors.deny_rule: an unknown claim key denies; CWT has no critical-claims mechanism

vectors.title: Claims map keys not in deterministic order
vectors.deny_rule: RFC 8949 core deterministic encoding: map keys sorted bytewise

vectors.title: Indefinite-length claims map
vectors.deny_rule: definite lengths only

vectors.title: Floating-point exp timestamp
vectors.deny_rule: integer Unix seconds only; no floating-point values anywhere

vectors.title: Duplicate aud claim key
vectors.deny_rule: no duplicate claim keys

vectors.title: crit omits hs_domain
vectors.deny_rule: crit sets are exact, not minimums

vectors.title: crit carries an unknown extension label
vectors.deny_rule: an unrecognized critical label denies; the label is also absent from the bucket

vectors.title: crit names hs_domain but the parameter is absent from the same protected bucket
vectors.deny_rule: RFC 9052: every crit label must occur in the same protected bucket

vectors.title: Duplicate crit entry
vectors.deny_rule: crit entries are unique and in ascending numeric-label order

vectors.title: crit entries in descending label order
vectors.deny_rule: entries use ascending numeric-label order

vectors.title: Credential-bound proof carrying hs_unattributed_key_set
vectors.deny_rule: the unattributed key set is absent whenever a credential is presented

vectors.title: Signature entry using deprecated polymorphic EdDSA (-8)
vectors.deny_rule: RFC 9864 fully-specified algorithms: Ed25519 components use -19

vectors.title: suite_id of 65 encoded bytes
vectors.deny_rule: proof-v1 cap: suite_id 1..64 encoded bytes

vectors.title: kid of 65 bytes
vectors.deny_rule: proof-v1 cap: kid 1..64 bytes

vectors.title: Required claim credential_hash absent rather than null
vectors.deny_rule: every listed claim is always present; inapplicable values encode as null

vectors.title: Credential presented with a null signed credential_hash
vectors.deny_rule: hash absence is permitted only when no credential is presented
vectors.notes: Presentation context: an at+jwt credential accompanies this proof.

vectors.title: Unattributed proof with no Nonce (server challenge)
vectors.deny_rule: the challenge is REQUIRED for unattributed proofs, before any replay-store insertion

vectors.title: alg and kid carried only in the unprotected header
vectors.deny_rule: algorithm and key identifiers in unprotected headers establish no authority

vectors.title: Unattributed key set carrying a key with no plan component
vectors.deny_rule: every key-set element must match exactly one plan component; a surplus element denies the complete proof rather than being ignored

vectors.title: Response proof carrying hs_unattributed_key_set
vectors.deny_rule: a self-asserted response key is never authoritative

vectors.title: Signature entry declaring a logical signer group absent from the plan
vectors.deny_rule: every signature entry matches exactly one plan component by group, alg, and kid

vectors.title: Tagged COSE_Sign1 (CBOR tag 18)
vectors.deny_rule: this closed profile carries no tags; the typ header performs object typing

vectors.title: Response proof whose cti does not match the request_id
vectors.deny_rule: a response proof can never verify for another request ID
